value: 2 hours suicide assessment, referral, treatment, and management training

requirements.quote: The committee shall be authorized to issue a temporary license to an applicant for a behavior analyst license or assistant behavior analyst license upon receipt of a complete application, submission of a fee as set by the committee by rule for behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst, and a showing of valid licensure as a behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst in another state

exists.quote: "Board", the behavior analyst advisory board within the state committee of psychologists

name.quote: "Board", the behavior analyst advisory board within the state committee of psychologists

authority.value: The board reviews applications, complaints, and certifying entities and makes recommendations to the committee; only after the board's recommendation and approval by majority vote may the committee make final decisions related to licensing, rules, complaint resolution, and approval of certifying entities.
authority.quote: Only after the board's recommendation and approval by majority vote may the committee make any final decisions related to licensing, rules and regulations, complaint resolution, approval of certifying entities or any actions bearing upon the practice of applied behavior analysis

national_certification.quote: "Certifying entity", the nationally accredited Behavior Analyst Certification Board, or other equivalent nationally accredited nongovernmental agency approved by the committee which certifies individuals who have completed academic, examination, training, and supervision requirements in applied behavior analysis

is_mandatory.quote: No persons shall practice applied behavior analysis unless they are: (1) Licensed behavior analysts

title_protection.quote: No person shall hold himself or herself out to be licensed behavior analysts or LBA, provisionally licensed behavior analyst or PLBA, provisionally licensed assistant behavior analyst or PLABA, temporary licensed behavior analyst or TLBA, or temporary licensed assistant behavior analyst or TLaBA, licensed assistant behavior analysts or LaBA in the state of Missouri unless they meet the applicable requirements.

scope_protection.quote: No persons shall practice applied behavior analysis unless they are: (1) Licensed behavior analysts; (2) Licensed assistant behavior analysts working under the supervision of a licensed behavior analyst

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substance or alcohol to an extent impairing ability to perform professional duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of guilt or guilty plea in criminal prosecution for offense directly related to duties and responsibilities of the occupation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of any state, of the United States, or of any country for any offense directly related to the duties and responsibilities of the occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing any permit or license or in obtaining permission to take any examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any permit or license issued under this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required under sections 337.300 to 337.345

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees or compensation by fraud, deception, or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition, or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonesty in performance of professional duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonesty in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed by sections 337.300 to 337.345

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of the chapter or any lawful rule adopted thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of sections 337.300 to 337.345, or of any lawful rule adopted thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonating any person holding a certificate, permit, or license, or allowing any person to use one's own credentials.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her certificate of registration or authority, permit, license, or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state, territory, federal agency, or country on grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in Missouri.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by sections 337.300 to 337.345 granted by another state, territory, federal agency, or country upon grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of insanity or incapacity by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged insane or incapacitated by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling any person to practice who is not registered and currently eligible to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by sections 337.300 to 337.345 who is not registered and currently eligible to practice as provided in sections 337.300 to 337.345

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a license based upon a material mistake of fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit, or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display a valid certificate or license if required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to display a valid certificate or license if so required by sections 337.300 to 337.345 or any rule promulgated thereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any professional trust or confidence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading, or deceptive advertisement or solicitation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation which is false, misleading, or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being guilty of unethical conduct as defined in the code of conduct adopted by the committee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of unethical conduct as defined in the code of conduct as adopted by the committee and filed with the secretary of state

definition_quote.value: The application of the principles, methods, and procedures of the experimental analysis of behavior and applied behavior analysis (including principles of operant and respondent learning) to assess and improve socially important human behaviors.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of applied behavior analysis", the application of the principles, methods, and procedures of the experimental analysis of behavior and applied behavior analysis (including principles of operant and respondent learning) to assess and improve socially important human behaviors.

value: Design, implementation, evaluation, and modification of treatment programs to change behavior of individuals
Design, implementation, evaluation, and modification of treatment programs to change behavior of groups
Direct observation, measurement, and functional analysis of relationships between environment and behavior
Changes and arrangements of contextual factors, antecedent stimuli, positive reinforcement, and other consequences
methods_authorized.quote: It includes, but is not limited to, applications of those principles, methods, and procedures to: (a) The design, implementation, evaluation, and modification of treatment programs to change behavior of individuals; (b) The design, implementation, evaluation, and modification of treatment programs to change behavior of groups; and (c) Consultation to individuals and organizations

tiered_license_levels.quote: No person shall hold himself or herself out to be licensed behavior analysts or LBA, provisionally licensed behavior analyst or PLBA, provisionally licensed assistant behavior analyst or PLABA, temporary licensed behavior analyst or TLBA, or temporary licensed assistant behavior analyst or TLaBA, licensed assistant behavior analysts or LaBA in the state of Missouri unless they meet the applicable requirements.

national_certification_body.quote: "Certifying entity", the nationally accredited Behavior Analyst Certification Board, or other equivalent nationally accredited nongovernmental agency approved by the committee which certifies individuals who have completed academic, examination, training, and supervision requirements in applied behavior analysis

national_certification_required_for_lice.quote: Have passed an examination and been certified as a board-certified behavior analyst by a certifying entity, as defined in section 337.300; Provide evidence of active status as a board-certified behavior analyst

assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.value: Licensed assistant behavior analysts shall work under the direct supervision of a licensed behavior analyst as established by committee rule.
assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.quote: Licensed assistant behavior analysts shall work under the direct supervision of a licensed behavior analyst as established by committee rule.

supervisee_technician_exemption.quote: An individual who has a bachelor's or graduate degree and completed course work for licensure as a behavior analyst and is obtaining supervised field experience under a licensed behavior analyst pursuant to required supervised work experience for licensure at the behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst level

temporary_license_available.quote: The committee shall be authorized to issue a temporary license to an applicant for a behavior analyst license or assistant behavior analyst license upon receipt of a complete application, submission of a fee as set by the committee by rule for behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst, and a showing of valid licensure as a behavior analyst or assistant behavior analyst in another state

temporary_license_max_days_per_year.quote: The temporary license shall expire upon issuance of a license or denial of the application but no later than ninety days from issuance of the temporary license. Upon written request to the committee, the holder of a temporary license shall be entitled to one extension of ninety days of the temporary license.

school_setting_exemption.quote: Persons who provide services under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA), 20 U.S.C. Section 1400, et seq., or Section 504 of the federal Rehabilitation Act of 1973, 29 U.S.C. Section 794, or are enrolled in a course of study at a recognized educational institution through which the person provides applied behavior analysis as part of supervised clinical experience shall be exempt from the requirements of this section.

scope_exclusions.quote: Applied behavior analysis does not include cognitive therapies or psychological testing, personality assessment, intellectual assessment, neuropsychological assessment, psychotherapy, cognitive therapy, sex therapy, psychoanalysis, hypnotherapy, family therapy, and long-term counseling as treatment modalities

criminal_background_check_required.quote: Provide two classified sets of fingerprints for processing by the Missouri state highway patrol under section 43.543. One set of fingerprints shall be used by the highway patrol to search the criminal history repository and the second set shall be forwarded to the Federal Bureau of Investigation for searching the federal criminal history files

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: Provide two classified sets of fingerprints for processing by the Missouri state highway patrol under section 43.543.

mandatory_reporting_of_disciplinary_acti.quote: If the applicant holds a license as a behavior analyst in another state, a statement from all issuing states verifying licensure and identifying any disciplinary action taken against the license holder by that state.

ethical_code_compliance_required.quote: All licensed behavior analysts and licensed assistant behavior analysts shall be bound by the code of conduct adopted by the committee by rule.

suicide_prevention_training_required.quote: Submit a complete application on a form approved by the committee, which shall include a statement that the applicant has completed two hours of suicide assessment, referral, treatment, and management training

advisory_board_composition.value: The behavior analyst advisory board is within the state committee of psychologists; composition is not specified in the ABA statutes but the board reviews applications, complaints, and certifying entities and makes recommendations to the committee.
advisory_board_composition.quote: "Board", the behavior analyst advisory board within the state committee of psychologists
